title: OAuth Trap
description: Northstar's customer portal relies on a legacy OAuth integration. The migration left multiple trust-boundary mistakes in the authorization flow. Reconstruct the OAuth exchange, inspect the client configuration, abuse the loose redirect handling, and recover an administrator session through flawed account linking.
hints: OAuth metadata and the application's client configuration are often more useful than the landing page.
Pay attention to how redirect URIs are validated. Prefix checks are not the same thing as exact origin validation.
The identity provider marks the email as unverified. Ask yourself whether the client actually cares about that field.
